boundary: Explicit positive dimensions specialize direct static global ARRAY declarations during offline translation. This does not reproduce controller variable loading, preexisting values or dynamic storage.

rules.documented: Section 2.5.2 permits * dimensions and requires their actual sizes to be established before the PC loads; explicit dimensions must agree with external storage.
rules.implemented: translate(array_shapes={name: dimensions}) and repeated CLI --array-shape NAME=DIM[,DIM] supply every outer dimension, including fixed ones. All are strict INTEGER in 1..32767; declared fixed dimensions must agree. Case-insensitive names are normalized; missing, duplicate, unused, malformed or rank-mismatched context is rejected.
rules.restriction: Specialization is explicit translation context, not discovered or authenticated controller configuration. The documented zero-size fallback is excluded. No VR/KCL parser, controller variable creation, dynamic resize or implicit dimensions.
rules.tests: tests/test_variable_arrays.py: dimensions, mixed constants, missing/conflicting/unused context and CLI/API controls

rules.documented: Variable-sized arrays are permitted in VAR, not TYPE, and only for static variables.
rules.implemented: Only direct global VAR ARRAY declarations containing * can use external shapes. Fixed dimensions retain constant/range checks. Named fixed ARRAY/STRUCTURE elements retain existing nominal and initialization guards; at most three total logical dimensions and 32767 scalar leaves.
rules.restriction: Wildcard TYPE definitions, fields and fresh routine-local storage remain blocked. Existing wildcard reference formals still take concrete caller storage; they do not consume external shape entries.
rules.tests: tests/test_variable_arrays.py: TYPE/field/local guards, rank/capacity limits, formals and named subarrays

rules.implemented: Resolved dimensions are embedded in generated storage and immutable tuple metadata Program.external_array_shapes. Reports preserve original wildcard/fixed dimensions, physical declaration locations, resolved outer/logical dimensions, canonical translation_context and its SHA-256. Source SHA-256 and context SHA-256 are separate. A different shape requires retranslation.
rules.restriction: The context supplies dimensions only: new offline globals keep existing uninitialized/unknown markers. No preexisting data, controller persistence/reload semantics or success status is invented. Runtime copy, reference capture, bounds, effect and read-only guards are unchanged.
